repo.name: docusaurus
repo.description: Easy to maintain open source documentation websites.

readme.summary: This README is for the Docusaurus monorepo root, not the @docusaurus/theme-common package specifically, providing no package-specific documentation.
readme.top_issue: README describes the entire Docusaurus project rather than the @docusaurus/theme-common package — no explanation of what this specific package does, its API, or how to use it.

common_complaints: High-severity security vulnerabilities not addressed urgently (RCE in serialize-javascript)
Multi-year backlog of feature requests (issues from 2021 still open)
Environment compatibility issues (Yarn PnP, non-HTTPS builds)
Slow progress on accepted features despite 'status: accepting pr' labels
praise_themes: Clear contributing guidelines and issue templates
Good first issue labeling for new contributors
Some quick issue resolution (CopyButton bug closed within days)
Active community discussion on proposals (16 comments on font discussion)
sentiment.summary: Project shows moderate engagement with some quick responses, but concerning security vulnerabilities remain open and multi-year-old feature requests indicate significant maintenance backlog.

communication.summary: The maintainer responses are generally helpful and clear, showing patience with repeated or basic questions. They provide technical depth where necessary but could be more detailed in some areas. New contributors are encouraged.

concerns: 354 open issues with no recent closures
No active contributors in past 6 months
No merged PRs in past 6 months
positive_signals: Repository still exists with recent commit timestamp
No backlog of open pull requests
maintenance.summary: This package shows clear signs of abandonment with zero development activity over the past 6 months and accumulating open issues.

changelog.summary: The changelog is well-categorized and appears complete, but lacks clear marking of breaking changes and migration guides.

governance.summary: The documentation outlines a clear path for contributors to become maintainers and indicates multiple people with merge rights, but lacks details on succession planning and decision-making processes.

project_metrics.description: Easy to maintain open source documentation websites.
